coordinate_policy: Coordinates remain null until a safe public check-in point is field-verified. The 30 km GET radius is measured from the verified point; do not infer coordinates from a broad district or venue centroid.
inclusion_policy: Scope is broad by design (decided 2026-11-16): waka, folk songs (minyo), lullabies, children's songs, and enka are all in scope.
Include only places with a documented connection to a named song or poem; record how the place connects to the song, not just that a monument exists.
Keep song types distinct: waka / folk_song / lullaby / children's_song / enka.
A song monument, documented transmission area, or documented performance site is eligible. One song may have more than one registered place (e.g. a transmission area and a monument).
Generic museums, shrines, and cultural facilities without a specific song connection are excluded.

records.name: 高槻市大塚地区
records.evidence_summary: 江戸時代の淀川三十石船の船頭が唄った船唄。高槻市大塚地区の人々による保存会が歌い継ぎ、大阪府指定無形民俗文化財として保存・普及活動を行っている。
